scope: Saved real-bag seeds rescored under current gap objective and existing MPPI common objective plus static soft cost; no dynamic cost. Ranking compares the same feasible saved controls, not separately optimized global optima. Microbenchmarks exclude geometry/MPPI/ROS. Direct value solves use batched numeric gradients (30 controls) with a 250ms cooperative per-candidate cap, not the production 50ms aggregate proposal budget. Their timing does not apply to a future analytic implementation.
